results.title: NuPlay: AI transformation, run on one self-improving platform | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hi Product Hunt, I'm hunting NuPlay today. Most enterprise AI projects follow the same arc: a promising pilot, a launch, and then slow decay. Policies change, products change, customers ask new questions, and the agent stays exactly as it was shipped. NuPlay is built around the opposite idea. It runs enterprise workflows in production and improves them after every run, with the agents, the systems they operate and the context they draw on in one platform. The platform comes together in five parts: NuPro is where you build the agents. You set behaviour, personality, speech, call handling, privacy and post-call analytics, then simulate the agent before you deploy it. Agents work across voice, chat, email and messaging, in support, sales, HR, vendor operations and marketing. NuStack makes [...] It’s all on one platform. The agents, the systems they operate in, and the context they draw on live in the same place, so improvements don’t get lost between tools. Deploy an agent, and it runs, learns and improves without a rebuild every time something changes.

Key features:

 Agents that improve after every run, powered by NuLoop, our self-improvement layer
 Agents, systems and context unified in one platform
 Production-ready agents for retail, consumer services, consumer goods and more
 Adapts to new policies, products and customer questions without manual rework

results.title: Nurix AI Rebrands as NuPlay AI to Advance a New Generation of Self-Improving AI Systems
results.content:
BENGALURU, India, Aug. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Nurix AI, an enterprise AI company building autonomous AI agents for complex business workflows, today announced that it has rebranded as NuPlay AI, reflecting its evolution from a conversational AI company into a platform for building and operating self-improving agentic systems across the enterprise.

Nurix AI Rebrands as NuPlay

Nurix AI Rebrands as NuPlay

 

NuPlay helps organizations redesign workflows around AI agents, deterministic automation and human judgment. Its systems can execute tasks, make decisions, coordinate work across enterprise software and use production feedback to improve performance over time. [...] Combined with the recent acquisition of Verloop.io, which expanded the company's conversational AI capabilities, the transition to NuPlay AI marks the company's next phase of growth. While the company's identity is changing, its operations, product capabilities, support services continue unchanged.

Today, 100+ enterprises use NuPlay to build and run agentic systems across complex business workflows. The platform enables AI agents to execute tasks, make decisions and coordinate work across enterprise software, while improving based on real-world production outcomes. [...] "Enterprise AI has reached an important turning point. It's no longer about whether AI can handle customer interactions, but whether those agents get better the longer they run, without a team of engineers manually intervening every week," said Mukesh Bansal, Founder and CEO, NuPlay AI. "That's what NuPlay was built to do. Customers already know us more by our platform than by our company name. Renaming the company simply reflects that reality. It sharpens our focus on building the best enterprise conversational AI platform while remaining committed to delivering measurable outcomes for our customers."
